answers.Q1: Anytime, mid-scene (Recommended): invent in the prose when the beat calls for it, note it in the OOC foot to keep or cut
answers.Q2: Both equal, mixed freely: either Trait can power any technique at any time
answers.Q3: Real side-effects of it (Recommended): anything the real phenomenon actually produces
answers.Q4: Mix by character: each character names their arts their own way
answers.Q5: Short description only: plain description in chat, no full card unless asked
answers.Q6: Everywhere, prose too: figures inline in prose as well as on cards (LitRPG-style)
answers.Q7: Whenever it looks cool: no frequency rule, new techniques whenever the spectacle earns it
answers.Q8: Canon once you keep it (Recommended): used, noted in the OOC foot, canon unless cut
